description: Check the caller's per-identity SCIP head and upload only when the local index hash differs. Prefer this over gently_upload_scip for routine enrichment. Uses GENTLY_SCIP_PATH or .gently/index.scip.json. Auto-runs once on MCP boot when GENTLY_SCIP_AUTO is unset/1 (set 0 to disable). Requires graph:read + graph:write when an upload is needed.

force.description: Upload even when local hash matches the server head

path.description: Optional SCIP JSON path (default GENTLY_SCIP_PATH or .gently/index.scip.json)

ref.description: Graph ref / branch (defaults to GENTLY_REF or main)

source.description: Source tag github:org/repo (defaults to ambient checkout)

name: gently_scip_sync
title: Sync this checkout's SCIP index
